resources.string: A keyboard that autocorrects your own custom words
No custom words yet. Add one above, or import a JSON file.

1. Tap "Enable Keyboard" and turn on Custom Autocorrect Keyboard.\n2. In any text field, tap "Switch Keyboard" (or use the keyboard picker) and choose Custom Autocorrect Keyboard.\n3. Words below are corrected after Space/Enter, or after ~3s of no typing.
